name: main-standard-baseline
description: Main viewport under Standard profile. Sanity check: this should show the demo organization graph (12 person nodes). If this is also empty, the rendering pipeline is broken regardless of Cinematic-specific modules.

checkpoints.name: main-standard
checkpoints.description: A 3D node-and-edge knowledge graph rendered in Qualia, dark theme, viewed in a browser viewport. DEFAULT look: solid readable nodes and edges with no heavy post-processing, and on-screen UI chrome present (gumball/gizmo and an FPS readout). It should look plain and functional rather than stylised.
